##### Project general facts

Tiger Sky Tower by Tiger Properties is a planned architectural jewel, set to become the world's highest complex with the most luxurious amenities. Featuring an iconic design and fascinating scenic views, this remarkable development offers notably designed flats with world-class restaurants, great adventures, and elegance in every detail. From the highest infinity pool in the world to the highest restaurant, Tiger Sky Tower perfectly represents Dubai's opulence and vibrancy, offering a seamless blend of urban allure and luxury at every turn.

Residents enjoy an unparalleled array of world-class amenities, including the highest infinity pool in the world for breathtaking views, world-class restaurants for exquisite dining, and a range of leisure and entertainment options. Every element is designed to provide a taste of future luxury living, with elegance in every detail and great adventures waiting at every corner.

Every residence at Tiger Sky Tower features modern finishing with high-quality materials and fully equipped kitchens, delivered fully furnished. Interiors showcase light brown and tan fabric for furniture, white painted walls and ceilings, decorative luxury wallpaper with white and beige patterns, dark brown wood for wall art, light beige fabric accents, and light cream-colored marble flooring. Each apartment is a masterpiece of design where elegance and comfort coexist in every hushed story.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in Business Bay, on the south side of Downtown Dubai, this exceptional location is known as a very stylish and up-to-date community at the forefront of the latest trends. The area is not just office spaces and buildings—it features hotel towers, amazing restaurants, and wonderful residential properties, creating a vibrant and fast-paced lifestyle.

The location is distinguished by its exceptional convenience and proximity to key destinations. Famous and international schools, medical facilities, supermarkets, banks, and finance centers are just minutes away, elevating the standard of living with easy and intuitive options. The area hosts plenty of events, including music festivals and celebrations, keeping life lively and engaging throughout the year.

For those seeking a residence that embodies urban energy, world-class amenities, and a prime Dubai address, Business Bay delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of style, connectivity, and vibrant community makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can seek refuge in a world full of pleasure, success, and fun.
